_metadata.description: Testing seams and coverage targets per unit-testing-architecture-steer: SQLite-backed repos, mocked handlers, UI component tests, BAS flows.

requirements.title: Per-domain SQLite-backed repository tests cover CRUD and error paths
requirements.description: Each `api/internal/<dom>/sqlite.go` has a sibling `sqlite_test.go` that exercises the repository against `:memory:` or `t.TempDir()` SQLite. No testcontainers. No Postgres.

validation.notes: `go test ./internal/... -run Sqlite` is green; coverage tooling reports per-domain coverage.

requirements.title: Handlers are tested against repository fakes, not the live SQLite
requirements.description: Each `api/handlers/<dom>/handlers_test.go` uses the co-located `internal/<dom>/mocks/` fake. Handler tests assert request decoding, response shape, and error mapping — not SQL behavior.

requirements.title: UI has a component test per top-level page and an a11y test for each
requirements.description: Library, Editor, Adoptions, Diff, Theme-switcher pages each ship a `*.test.tsx` and an `*.a11y.test.tsx` using the template's stock testing setup.

validation.notes: `pnpm test -- --run` is green; axe-core a11y assertions pass.

requirements.title: BAS flows cover the primary user journeys
requirements.description: Browser coverage includes the live preview/catalog render path, version-pinned five-stage component evidence, story-sheet artifacts, and the adoption obligation surfaces. Additional end-to-end flows remain planned for index/list, edit-and-preview, select-element, adopt-and-detect-drift, dep-mismatch-blocks-adopt, and theme-switch-applies.

validation.notes: The full-catalog preview sweep passed across all 11 components and example frames. Remaining broad product journeys are still tracked as planned coverage.

requirements.title: PROGRESS.md status mirrors test gates honestly
requirements.description: Every requirement has a PROGRESS.md row with `planned | in progress: <test gate> | complete: <test names>`. A row never claims `complete` if the named tests are not green.

validation.notes: Auditor cross-checks PROGRESS.md complete-claims against the test report on each release.

requirements.title: Catalog source gates cover type, lint, render, and component-experience claims
requirements.description: Catalog source is tested independently from the host UI: authored TSX files pass catalog TypeScript and ESLint gates, story contracts lint without raw node-tag corruption, eligible versions render in Chromium, and evidence freshness is enforced against each story contract.

validation.notes: `pnpm run catalog:check` passed and a temporary TypeScript error failed as expected during Phase 3.
`pnpm run test:preview-evidence` delegates the catalog browser gate to BAS CaptureService and is kept out of the bounded unit coverage command.
Experience phase live BAS calibration: clean run 20260710-131340-38f3addd, ghost-claim advisory failure run 20260710-131446-30feba68, clean post-removal run 20260710-131538-31dc1994.
